sampling.interpretation: Both architectures and all readouts share the waveform under the same key. Four training fits per architecture, each evaluated on its own waveform group.

metrics.block_errors: Recounted independently from the per-frame failure strings, checked against stored counts.
metrics.paired_old_to_signed: First cell counts old failed / signed passed. A positive old-minus-signed BLER indicates fewer errors with signed.
metrics.other_metrics: Information BER, raw coded BER, coded-bit BCE and the strict |LLR|>8 fraction use the recorded per-model/arm error or sum totals and their bit denominators. Per-bit observations are not stored.
